items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: So they called us to get an eight piece group together to play with Joe Williams... And Miles Davis was supposed to be there... He was there.

ctx.x: And Miles Davis was supposed to be there, and Joe Williams. He was there. They made it through because — Sarah Vaughan couldn’t make it. But Joe made it, but his band didn’t make it. So they called us to get an eight piece group together to play with Joe Williams. And he was very nice, but every time he’d see a lady piano player they’d go — like they’re in pain. And it really made me mad but I knew I could do whatever he wanted. He says, “Okay.” He put the music up there. And I started playing Blues in G, I’ll…
